source: Project Operating System Phase 2 - Migration Engine
description: Official phase sequence for future migrations.

items.description: Migration intent and scope are documented.
Current behavior, files and risk are checked before changes.
Current outputs, files and rollback references are captured.
A draft change plan exists but is not approved as final.
Post-change checks are defined for future execution.
Migration gates passed and manual approval was recorded.
Migration completed and report was recorded.
Migration did not satisfy required checks.
Previous state was restored and confirmed.
Migration was stopped by decision before completion.

notes: The sequence describes future process control and does not drive automation in Phase 2.
